subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Huron - Amberley
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Huron - Amberley
Subsurface scientific mooring temporarily established 5 metres below the surface at:
44 07.224N 081 50.223W
 44 07.236N 081 50.261W
The mooring has two points; the first being the scientific instrumentation and the second being the end of the poly line.
Mariners are requested to stay clear 100 metres and not set nets or drag the lakebed between the two points.
